summary: Reviewed current W-014 implementation across SLC-01, SLC-02 and SLC-03 including the dedicated full-view canvas and drawer corrections D-01/D-02 and checklist ordering D-03. Independent run: node --test packages/ui/lib/*.test.mjs, 44 pass; library.break, library-storage.break, library-operations and MCP library.boundary.break compiled tests, 19 pass. Killers cover portable adoption, immutable adopted evidence after edits/deletes, stale versions, pointer confinement, cross-site poison, exact request recovery after lost response/reload, denied recovery storage preventing writes, deleted provenance, route separation, selected-stage drawer open/close, disabled canvas edits, conflict visibility inside preview and checklist state/count preservation. No confirmed blockers. Builder browser evidence separately documents real desktop/mobile and disposable save/default/adopt/edit/delete flows; test harness uses controlled UI primitives for interaction logic. Bounded hunt; no load tests.
